name: Hazing Policy Notice to Students by Coaches and Sponsors
description: Students are informed of the hazing Policy and AR; coaches and sponsors inform participants at the start of each activity / season and as needed.
deadline: at the start of the activity / season and as needed
quote: Coaches and activity sponsors shall be familiar with the District’s Policy and Administrative Regulations regarding hazing and inform students of their requirements at the start of the activity/season and on an as-needed basis during the activity/season.
